## Troll Font Pack

![Troll Font Pack preview](https://i.postimg.cc/gjdp8Hp6/Chat-GPT-Image-15-Sept-2026-10-26-28.png)

A collection of bizarre and deliberately impractical font replacements for League of Legends.

Choose your favorite font version:

- **Adobe Blank** — makes all supported characters completely invisible.
- **Flow Circular** — replaces text with smooth, unreadable bars.
- **Libre Barcode 39 Extended** — turns letters and numbers into barcodes.
- **Linefont Condensed** — displays text as compact dot-like symbols.
- **Redacted** — turns text into solid censorship bars.

Each version includes Unicode coverage information showing which languages and character sets it supports.

Click on **Versions** to download your preferred font:

![Version selection](https://i.postimg.cc/GhCKqnSy/version.png)

Got an idea for another troll font, mod, or League UI change? Send me your recommendations! I’m always looking for strange new ideas to make.
